activities.name: The card room at the Admiral
activities.text: Up the back stairs past a desk clerk who does not look up. Philadelphia doctors losing their summer money.

activities.name: A porch on Hughes Street
activities.text: Rocking chairs, iced tea, and the whole afternoon to say nothing at all.

activities.name: Up the lighthouse
activities.text: The kids count the steps out loud. From the top you can see Delaware.

activities.name: Sunset Beach and the concrete ship
activities.text: Cape May diamonds at the waterline and the sun going down behind the wreck.

activities.name: The fish houses at the landing
activities.text: Coffee with the men who own the boats. Boats go places at night that nobody writes down.

activities.name: Mass at St. Brendan's
activities.text: The summer Mass, the windows open to the ocean.

activities.name: Look at investments
activities.text: A tired hotel that needs a partner; a lot on Beach Avenue with a sign on it.
